lines.text: Herzog calls them to the hall at first light. No ceremony. Tilly's reports laid out in order on the table, weighted at the corners with cannon shot.
Tilly. You have been drilling the guard on your own authority. It is now my authority. Captain of the town's defense. Build me soldiers.
Yes. First muster by week's end. Thank you. I won't waste it.

He fields armies, Tycho. Armies that aren't men, drawn from the same well your etchings drink from. A sword and a brave brother won't answer that. We need everything this town is becoming, and faster.
Then I don't stop. The runs feed the forge, and the forge feeds the wall. And if the emperor's strength has a source, I've seen her face. That's more than he knows about us.
Outside, the drills go on into the dark. To the west the roads are quiet. Nobody in the town mistakes that for peace anymore.
